summary: Runtime backend registry. _backend_registry dict maps CONST_STORAGE_PROVIDER_TYPE → backend class. register_storage_backend(provider_type) is a decorator that registers a backend at import time. get_storage_backend(provider_type, auth_params) instantiates and returns the backend. get_registered_backends() and clear_registry() (test-only) are provided.
extension_points: @register_storage_backend(CONST_STORAGE_PROVIDER_TYPE.X) on a backend class registers it in the global dict
lifecycle_notes: Registration is triggered by importing storage_backends — the package root does `from . import storage_backends` to ensure all backends are registered before any get_storage_backend() call
clear_registry() exists only for test isolation — do not call in production
documentation_hooks: Extension authors adding a new backend must: (1) add a provider type to CONST_STORAGE_PROVIDER_TYPE, (2) decorate their class with @register_storage_backend, (3) ensure the module is imported
risks: Circular import risk if backend modules import from facade before registration completes

evidence.detail: Verifies all provider types have a registered backend
